voice: Warm, plain, first person plural ("we", "our boat"). A small local crew talking, not a marketing team.
Short sentences. No exclamation stacking, no emoji walls (0-2 emoji max).
Never invent facts: no prices, no guest numbers over 5, no promises about seeing wildlife.
Never write "link in bio" more than once a week — rotate the call to action.
English first. A short Portuguese line is welcome now and then, never a full translation.

facts.boat: Karnic R8S, private boat, skipper included, two skippers, no other group on board
trips: Day Trip: 2h30 or 3h, leaves 10:00 or 14:00. Câmara de Lobos, Cabo Girão, swim and paddle stop at Fajã dos Padres, Ribeira Brava. Swimming is on this trip only.
Sunset Trip: 2h or 2h30, leaves 1h15 before the sun goes down, so the time changes through the year. Same coast, turns at Cabo Girão or Ribeira Brava. No swimming.
included_on_every_trip: drone footage when the weather allows
never_say: a fixed sunset time such as 18:30

seo._about: Search words for every channel (lib/seo.mjs). Leads open a caption that does not name the place in its first 150 characters; alt is the default alt text of a photo. Keep them true for every trip: Cabo Girao is on all trips, swimming is the Day Trip only, sunset leaves 1h15 before the sun goes down. Words come from scripts/data/seo-targets.json.
